nl: Add the option delaycompress after compress in etc/logrotate.d/orders, with the same indentation.
oracle_program:
edit "etc/logrotate.d/orders" changes: [{replace: "    compress
", with: "    compress
    delaycompress
"}]
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/logrotate.d/orders'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('    compress\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('    compress\n', '    compress\n    delaycompress\n'))
EOF
